header.title: Other Activities
header.lead: Beyond teaching, research, and consulting, I keep a creative and public-facing practice made of poetry, music, video, tutorials, and community-oriented expression.

data.text: These activities are not a separate life from my technical work. They reveal the same habits from another angle: writing to clarify emotion, performing to connect with people, teaching publicly to make knowledge travel, and using digital platforms as spaces where ideas can be archived, shared, discussed, and revisited.
